body: Quick pass (UMA) @ 78a23c8b: quick gate green on the final head (tools, motion, app, ui), clippy clean, no golden moved, 'loading never moves posted numbers' pinned, body complete. Kept as a DRAFT on purpose: stacked on #1070 (on #1060). Reviewer note: SetWorkMaterial now reseeds matching tools' rpm and their ops' feed (one undo step, counted in the status line). That's an intended posted-value change on an explicit command.
M5 is refreshing this PR with main (its author session has been idle; last commit 2026-11-12T04:47Z)

Merged main to resolve conflicts (tools/tools.rs, tools/catalog_asset.rs, app/lib.rs, project/file.rs, ui state.rs and egui_app/mod.rs, 7 Tool-literal test files, commands/tool.rs: keep both sides - main's #891 turning field alongside this branch's catalog and cutting; ChangeTool::new delegates to main's judged() which runs catalog_gate and cutting_gate; main's recorded_post_streams Tool literal gets catalog/cutting defaults). Targeted gate: tool_catalog_fields 7, tool_cutting_rows 11, recorded_post_streams 2, mill2d_b 9, mill2d_c 9, golden_cl 25, solid_law_goldens 5, operations 117, all turning_* suites, ui tool* 56, motion drilling 34 + center_cut_owed 7, camcraft-tools 72/3 pass; clippy -D warnings (app, ui, motion, tools) clean. Ready for a re-check (/resolve-conflicts check).
Quick pass (M5): body complete, gate reported green on this head, no open requested change; flagged ready for review. Conflicts with main (if any) are refreshed at merge time (PROCESS_VERSION 31).

Merged main into this branch at merge time (maintainer's session, maintainer edits).

Resolution:
- 14 conflicted files were all keep-both (this PR inserted lines, main's side empty): commands/tool.rs (cutting_gate), project/file.rs (cutting_data in ToolDto, both directions), tools/tools.rs (Tool.cutting, validity clause, probe/torch tools), tools/catalog_asset.rs, ui state.rs and egui_app/mod.rs, and the Tool literals in golden_cl, mill2d_b, mill2d_c, operations, recorded_post_streams (main's ToolCatalog::default() kept, plus cutting), solid_law_goldens, motion drilling/tests.rs, center_cut_owed.
- Separate commit: `cutting: Vec::new()` added to three Tool literals main introduced (tools/electrode.rs, tests/thread_mill_rim.rs, tests/hole_wall_flats.rs). Then a second clean merge of main (it moved meanwhile). Diff vs main is the PR's own 33 files; no snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION untouched.

Gate: workspace cargo check all-targets OK; clippy -D warnings on tools/motion/app/ui OK; quick-gate suites OK (tools lib, motion center_cut_owed + cross_invariance, 119 app suites incl. tool_cutting_rows, cutting_data, project_roundtrip); ui lib + 9 suites OK (CWD crates/ui).

Pushed by the maintainer's session (maintainer edits); needs a review of this head (6dffc220). PR was ready, turned back into a draft for the push.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 6dffc220cf38aa29bdf5f8d1adcfd7ff6f9021d8 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge** (full review at 6dffc220, after the merge-time refresh).

**What looks good**
- Refresh hand edits checked: `git diff origin/main HEAD` has 781 insertions and only 4 deletions, all of them lines this PR itself reworded or replaced (a doc line in `cutting_data.rs`, `Ok(Self { prev, next })`, the MCP `add_tool` definition text, the `SetWorkMaterial` status line). Nothing of main's was dropped. The 14 keep-both files, `recorded_post_streams.rs` and the `cutting: Vec::new()` follow-up in `tools/electrode.rs`, `thread_mill_rim.rs` and `hole_wall_flats.rs` are all in order. The last merge commit has an empty remerge-diff.
- Project file: `ToolDto.cutting_data` is additive and `skip_serializing_if = Vec::is_empty`. Old projects load unchanged, and a tool without rows saves byte-identical (pinned). No version bump and not breaking. An unknown material word refuses the file by name (`cutting_rows_dto.rs`).
- Prime Directive: nothing runs on load. A row moves posted rpm/feed only inside a command, one undo step each (`AddTool`, `ChangeTool` on a table edit, `SetWorkMaterial`, `EditOperationLinks`). The status line says how many tools and operations moved. Rows are validated at command creation by tool name (finite rpm/feed above zero, torch rpm 0, no duplicate material), and `Tool::is_sane` applies the same law at file read. No unwrap/expect found in the new code.
- CAM choices stay user parameters: the tool's own rpm/feed remain the fallback, and no per-material stepdown/stepover is added (recorded as a deliberate omission).
- Everything Is a Command: the editor (`ui/egui_app/tool_cutting_rows.rs`) only edits the draft; Apply/Add go through `ChangeTool`/`AddTool`. MCP `add_tool` takes `cutting_data` and `get_job` shows it. The missing MCP tools for stating the material (#732) and editing a tool (#1062) already exist as issues.
- Layering and placement: pure model in `camcraft-tools`, seam in `app` reads the world. No new `Cargo.toml` or `camcraft-*` dependency lines. No snapshot PNG, CHANGELOG, `.github`, scripts or process-file changes. The decisions file `docs/decisions/890-cutting-data-per-material.md` is present. Body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #890`, and commit subjects are conventional.

| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (cwd `crates/ui`) | 640 passed (5 ignored) |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-tools -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

Not run: the quick gate's other whole-suite entries (other app/ui suites that only pick up a `Tool` literal) and the `#[ignore]`d snapshot lane.

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- `crates/tools/src/tools.rs` is 751 lines and `crates/ui/src/state.rs` 4429; both were already over 400. This PR adds 6 and 14 lines, and puts the new logic in its own modules.
- A UI change without before/after screenshots: the maintainer's note on UI PRs says these get screenshots in the description. The editor is one collapsed header with material/rpm/feed rows.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Merge-time refresh class: DELTA (main merged into the branch with keep-both resolutions in 14 files plus one compile-fix commit adding `cutting: Vec::new()` at three `Tool` literals main added). Stands on the full review of this head, 6dffc220, in issuecomment-6840920283. Flagged ready for the merge; nothing is pushed after this.
